subject.title: fix(macos): skip unresolved dashboard auth templates

question: Should this PR land with local macOS auth strings matching `${NAME}` or `$NAME` treated as SecretRefs rather than literal credentials, once real app proof is added?
rationale: The code aligns with core SecretRef parsing and fixes a P0 dashboard lockout, but it also changes shipped local macOS auth-config interpretation for exact shorthand-shaped literal strings.

options.title: Require proof, then land grammar-aligned fix
options.body: Keep the current parser-contract approach, require a redacted real OpenClaw.app plus LaunchAgent dashboard proof, and land it as the canonical fix for the linked issue.

options.title: Preserve literal compatibility by default
options.body: Ask for a narrower variant that avoids changing existing literal `$NAME` or `${NAME}` local credentials, accepting more divergence from the core SecretRef contract.

options.title: Pause for broader macOS auth consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR until the adjacent LaunchAgent env-wrapper work is resolved so the macOS auth fallback path changes in one coordinated maintainer-owned pass.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then land grammar-aligned fix
recommendation.body: Keep the current parser-contract approach, require a redacted real OpenClaw.app plus LaunchAgent dashboard proof, and land it as the canonical fix for the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete landed the current GatewayEndpointStore implementation and has recent macOS dashboard/gateway history, so this compatibility choice is closest to that ownership trail.
